method: GML-L1: grammar-closed maximal weak library + KKT-certified lazy L1 column generation
solver: exact L1 via LARS on active columns; IRL1 uses w=1/(|beta|+eps); STRidge is PDE-FIND control

grammar.weak_form_note: D_x^k(x^a f(u)) is evaluated by moving derivatives to the test function; derivative products are a later jet-library extension.

sga_compare_result.json.judge: SGA 选出的项按余弦相似度归到常见候选项（< 0.9 记为 other），集合等于真项才算选对
